einzeiler: Pop culture, pop history, and heavy doses of homosexual foolishness.
kurzfassung: The hosts discuss recent entertainment news, including major West End and reality television casting updates. stichpunkte: Jonathan Bailey steps away from the West End production of Sunday in the Park with George following Ariana Grande's departure.

A serial butt-sniffer is arrested at a Southern California Marshall's department store.
Sara Bareilles releases her grief-inspired new album, Good Grief, earning high praise for her songwriting craft.
The band Oat and Freddy offers a fun, 80s-inspired new wave sound reminiscent of campy synth pop.
Ina Garten handles a pointed interview question about Martha Stewart with characteristic grace and subtle shade.

The comic book character would not exist in her iconic modern form today if not for the intervention of the famous feminist leader.
A bizarre online movement encourages young men to forgo basic hygiene and try to boost their natural scent through extreme methods.

clips.hook: The unspoken rule of city traffic
clips.text: Because proper left-turn signals are practically nonexistent in Los Angeles, drivers rely on an unspoken rule allowing two cars to slip through the intersection after the light turns yellow.
